source.data_freshness: nightly Mon-Fri; weekly/annual per variable; from Skatteverket
source.attribution: Not required (CC0); courtesy attribution to SCB.

transport.base_url: provided with the certificate on registration (request via scbforetag@scb.se)
transport.record_path: unknown — confirm against SCB postbeskrivning + authenticated response

pagination.notes: Max 2,000 rows per request; max 10 requests per 10 seconds per user. Pagination mechanics improve under the Sept 2026 API-key model.

auth.obtain: Request certificate + accept API terms via scbforetag@scb.se

mapping_rules.company_name_fallback: företagsnamn (prefer Bolagsverket organisationsnamn as legal name).
mapping_rules.vat_registered: moms register flag (use to validate a derived SE+orgnr+01 VAT number).
mapping_rules.local_units[]: one entry per CFAR workplace: {cfar, name, address, kommun, lan, sni, size_class, main_or_subsidiary}.

fixture_requirements: company with multiple CFAR workplaces (huvud + del)
company with VAT + employer + F-tax flags all set
company with missing optional flags / no workplaces

live_test_plan.smoke: After obtaining the certificate, request a small bounded page (<=2,000 rows) of företag + arbetsställe records and confirm field keys against the postbeskrivning PDFs.
live_test_plan.full: Page the full register in 2,000-row windows (10 req/10 s cap) to build the orgnr + workplace universe; this seed feeds Bolagsverket enrichment.

blockers: Requires a free SCB client certificate (request + accept terms via scbforetag@scb.se). Not obtained — no record pulled.
Concrete base URL / endpoint paths are issued with the certificate and are not public.
Exact JSON field keys must be confirmed against the postbeskrivning PDFs and a real response.
Auth model changes to API key in September 2026 — client must support both certificate and API-key modes.
